notes.title: Carry The Glass 2.0 Big Update
notes.content:
Carry The Glass 2.0.0 Update is Out Now!Here is everything new in this massive update:



Brand New Season & Map – The Lighthouse

Our biggest addition yet! The Lighthouse level is here, filled with brand new obstacles, tricky platforming sections, and the ultimate friendship tester: the Crab Boss. This map is designed to challenge both you and your friend to the limit as you (once again) try to carry the fragile glass safely… or at least try. Prepare to laugh, shout, and maybe rage a little more than usual!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45245666/caa29e39797692628cc01b5cc2cbb716aceca498.png"]




Cosmetic Item Drops

You can now earn random cosmetic drops simply by playing the game for a certain amount of time! Dress up your character with hilarious new outfits to stand out in style. All cosmetic items can be traded or sold on the Steam Marketplace, so you can show off or make a little profit from your rare finds.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45245666/8c76e8ea9a96d0105952a77ce664d157911f9c60.gif"]




Improved Glass Carrying Mechanic

Each player can now lift and control their own side of the glass independently! You can push or pull your partner depending on the distance between you, allowing for more precise teamwork (and more opportunities to mess each other up).

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45245666/2d360de97a373536a41d4479e8ccfd53c59b97d7.gif"]




Voice & Text Chat

Communicating with your teammate is now easier than ever! You can talk directly in-game with voice chat or type quick messages with the new text chat feature – perfect for strategizing or just blaming each other when the glass breaks.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45245666/8979e4b9a561a2b0451c838dccbf0820a95e7511.gif"]




New UI Design

We’ve completely redesigned the user interface to be cleaner, more modern, and more responsive. Navigation is smoother, menus are more intuitive, and everything looks sharper than ever before.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45245666/b73aa6eb5776710c28e342b8234f555b01d62af5.jpg"]




UI, Accessibility & Graphics Overhaul

We’ve polished the overall look of the game, improved accessibility options, and refreshed the visuals for an even better gameplay experience.



Now Available in 13 Languages

Carry The Glass is now playable in:

English

German

Turkish

Portuguese

Korean

French

Polish

Russian

Spanish

Chinese

Japanese

Ukrainian

Swedish

New Achievements – Now 19 in Total!

With the new Lighthouse level, we’ve added several brand-new achievements for you to unlock, bringing the total number of achievements in the game to 19! Will you be able to collect them all?

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45245666/a717ccaa24c23e67a618b474ba3b6ae7db16fcc4.png"]

Leaderboards

Compete against other players and see who can carry the glass the fastest, the furthest, or with the least amount of breakage. Bragging rights included.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45245666/9ef3ab331e1bf46e9915b0f2f5f5b0d7f0d67017.jpg"]




This is the biggest update we’ve ever done, and the entire game has been rewritten from scratch. While we’ve tested it extensively, you might still run into some bugs or unexpected issues. If that happens, please reach out to us via Discord so we can assist you quickly.




If you prefer the old version or run into major issues, you can switch to the Carry The Glass Old branch on Steam at any time. We’ll continue working hard to improve the new version so that everyone can enjoy it to the fullest.




It’s truly amazing to see so many people having fun and creating content around something we built. We have plenty more exciting plans for the future, and we’re not stopping anytime soon (you won’t get bored, trust us!).




[previewyoutube="CvTwcJog4R0;full"][/previewyoutube]

Carry The Glass Presskit 


Thank you so much for your support, see you in-game!

notes.title: Carry The Glass 2.0 Big Update Coming on 15th of August!
notes.content:
We have a new big update coming out on 15th of August!Here is a breakdown:
New season new Map!! The Lighthouse level introduces a lot of new obstacles and challenges for you and your friend to break the glass for the millionth time. We made sure you to have a hard time and get mad at your friend again at the Crab Boss.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45245666/caa29e39797692628cc01b5cc2cbb716aceca498.png"]

New cosmetics. You have a chance to get a random cosmetic item drop if you play for a certain amount of time. Wear your new costumes to add a new level of goofiness. Also you can trade or sell these items on the Steam Marketplace.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45245666/8c76e8ea9a96d0105952a77ce664d157911f9c60.gif"]

Improved glass carrying mechanic. Each player can lift their own side of the glass and push or pull the other player depending on the distance between them.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45245666/2d360de97a373536a41d4479e8ccfd53c59b97d7.gif"]

Improved User Interface, accessibility options and overall graphics.

New languages. Carry The Glass now supports 13 different languages;

English

German

Turkish

Portuguese

Korean

French

Polish

Russian

Spanish

Chinese

Japanese

Ukrainian

Swedish

New Achievements, with the new level we have added a bunch of other achievements for you to unlock!

Leaderboards.

 

Hopefully not but you might experience bugs or other issues with this update as the game has been rewritten from scratch. If you do please contact us through Discord so we can help you as soon as possible.



Also if you want you can switch to the “Carry The Glass Old” branch on steam to play the previous version of the game if you don’t like the new version or have frustrating bugs. In the meantime we will be doing our best to make the game as perfect as possible so that everyone can have fun.

 

Lastly, it is really amazing to see so much people have fun and create content of something we have made ourselves. We have a lot more exciting plans for the game and we won’t stop until you get bored of it! (which won’t happen btw)

Thank you so much and see you on Aug 15th!

notes.title: What Is Next?
notes.content:
Good day gamers,
We would like to share some upcoming news about what is next for "Carry The Glass" and some more!

First of all thank you all for playing our game, we are still as excited as the day we released it and we would like to give more to our players, so here are some of the things we would like to tell you about...


New Level
If you have noticed there is a new button in the world creation menu and we are working on a new level for you to break that glass infinitely more times!

Speedrun.com
We now have a speedrun.com page live! If you have any speedrun attempts, we would love to see them!!

Bugs
Fixing annoying bugs in the game such as achievements and controllers is our primary focus right now and we promise they will be fixed in the next big update so stay tuned.

New Games
Even though our brains got mushy from developing non-stop, we are working on new games for you to experience!


We are very hopeful and excited for the future! As always, your feedback is invaluable to us, so don’t hesitate to share your thoughts. Happy gaming!

The SlugShot Games Team

notes.title: Revamped UI and Enhanced Features!
notes.content:
We’re thrilled to announce a major update for our game on Steam! This update brings a fresh look, improved functionality, and a more intuitive experience for all players. Let’s dive into the details of what’s new:

New UI Design
We’ve completely overhauled the user interface to make it more modern, sleek, and user-friendly. Navigating through menus and options is now smoother than ever, ensuring you spend less time tinkering and more time playing.

Key Updates in This Patch
Enhanced Settings Menu
We’ve revamped the settings menu to give you more control over your gaming experience. From graphics to audio, everything is now easier to customize.

Adjustable/Remappable Controls
Personalize your gameplay like never before! You can now fully customize your controls to suit your preferences, whether you’re using a keyboard, mouse, or controller.

Sneak Peek at the New Menus
Main Menu
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45245666/17e3b1ecea1ff0afab48c166ec283cde5c2b8b4f.png
The main menu has been redesigned to be more visually appealing and functional. Everything you need is just a click away!

Settings Menu
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45245666/28244c2793998b6d369bb1e09a82334b7ede9e76.png
The updated settings menu offers a cleaner layout and more options to fine-tune your experience.

Languages
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45245666/f46440b99d02c6d5ab501a212e33ffe3fcb1ffdc.png
We’ve revamped the Language Selection feature to make it more intuitive and user-friendly! While language support was already available in the previous UI, we’ve made significant improvements to ensure a smoother and more accessible experience for players worldwide

Lobby Creation
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45245666/9cb036229ee7c965110ba7bea9241cf1e0a13f2d.png
Creating a lobby is now more intuitive, with clearer options and a streamlined process.

Joining a Lobby
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45245666/e47fb37659dde5dbb644e01532a2d2b521ecb02c.png
Joining your friends has never been easier. The new lobby interface makes it simple to find and connect with others.

Stay Tuned for More!
This update is just the beginning. We’re constantly working on new features and improvements to make your experience even better. Make sure to follow SlugShot Games to stay updated on our latest projects and announcements!

We hope you enjoy the new changes as much as we enjoyed creating them. As always, your feedback is invaluable to us, so don’t hesitate to share your thoughts. Happy gaming!

The SlugShot Games Team

notes.title: New Game Mode: Baby Mode & Network Improvements!
notes.content:
new game mode and some important technical improvements!


 Introducing "Baby Mode" - a more forgiving experience with additional checkpoints for players who want a gentler challenge!

notes.title: Hotfix - New Settings & Character Movement Polish
notes.content:
Update Notes:

We're excited to bring you a new update packed with enhancements based on your valuable feedback! Here’s what’s new:

Mouse Invert Option: Responding to community requests, we've added an invert option for mouse controls, allowing for a more personalized gameplay experience.

Settings Overhaul: We've revamped the settings menu for a more intuitive user experience, making it easier to customize your gameplay.

Character Movement: The sliding degrees and friction values for character movement have been adjusted to improve gameplay fluidity and responsiveness.

Server Name Fix: We’ve resolved an issue where server names could exceed the player count limit, ensuring a cleaner and more organized multiplayer experience.

Local CO-OP Difficulty Bug Fix: Fixed the bug preventing players from selecting a difficulty level for local co-op modes.

Thank you for your continued support and feedback! We’re committed to making the game even better, so stay tuned for more updates!

notes.title: Local Co-op With Split Screen And LAN Mode
notes.content:
Local Co-op & Split Screen LAN Mode Now Live!

Enjoy multiplayer with friends locally or over LAN!

We’re excited to roll out our latest update, introducing Local Co-op with Split Screen and LAN Mode! Whether you're playing with friends on the same device or connecting multiple computers via LAN, this update brings more multiplayer flexibility to the game.

Split Screen for Local Co-op!
In Local Co-op, two players can now play together on the same screen using split screen.  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45245666/d91badcab4fe337303d0d47a8ffa4676caa26a82.png
See the split screen gameplay in action!

Multiplayer Mode Selection!
From the new multiplayer menu, you can now select between Local Co-op, LAN, or Online play.  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45245666/7718416bfb962fda4515d6a323ae9215eed04755.png
Check out the new mode selection screen!

Host a LAN Party!
In LAN Mode, you can now connect two computers to play together seamlessly without an internet connection.  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45245666/034f3fe8b4b9aff02e58988cf8672049c98aa123.png
Here’s a sneak peek of the LAN lobby creation options!

Make sure to update your game and start playing with your friends using these exciting new multiplayer options!
